# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Enforcement

To report unacceptable behavior, contact the maintainer privately via GitHub: open a [security advisory](https://github.com/LabOverWire/stitch/security/advisories/new) marked as a conduct report, or DM [@fabracht](https://github.com/fabracht).

The maintainer will review and respond as quickly as practical. All reports are kept confidential.
